authority: grammars guide presentation only; names cannot define mechanics/canon/rarity

rarity_styles.ordinary: practical functional action/tool/material/form; no mythic importance
rarity_styles.personalized: behavioral descriptor, method or local motif; personal without historic claim
rarity_styles.rare: specific metaphor or supplied local lore, recognizable identity
rarity_styles.unique: restrained specific event/consequence/mystery supported by canonical facts
rarity_styles.legendary_chain: supplied historic/world-event significance and approved exceptional evidence only

content_grammars.ability: action, motion, impact or brief function-grounded metaphor
content_grammars.skill: learned domain, method or enduring competency
content_grammars.spell: supported effect plus casting behavior, supplied magical tradition and motif
content_grammars.title: what knowledgeable people would call this player for actual behavior; presentation-only allowed explicitly
content_grammars.class: enduring role identity from broader persistent evidence
content_grammars.class_evolution: accepted role ancestry plus actual behavioral/mechanical delta
content_grammars.item: separate ordinary, personalized, rare and artifact identity
content_grammars.weapon: supported item function, material, maker or accepted history
content_grammars.armor: supported item function, material, maker or accepted history
content_grammars.artifact: supplied historical identity, never ordinary vendor equipment inflated
content_grammars.quest: situation and people; mystery must be supported
content_grammars.unique_opportunity: unexpected supported observation/reaction, never fabricated contradiction
content_grammars.legendary_chain: accepted naming family develops through consequences
content_grammars.npc: dedicated name task using supplied species/people/culture/region/role and applicable parts
content_grammars.faction: function, supplied culture, self-image and appropriate organization form
content_grammars.discovery: validated discovery context; no firstness from name
content_grammars.world_event: accepted world-event facts and specific consequence

generic_token_policy: advisory frequency/context review; no absolute ban
ranking_policy: Compute only objective collision/length facts; subjective values remain reviewer/model-visible judgments, never fabricated deterministic scores
